subject: Hosted -> On‑Prem transition: architecture onboarding & on‑call planning
messages:

To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodesk.com>
Cc: Matt Greene <matt.greene@orbithealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted -> On‑Prem transition: architecture onboarding & on‑call planning

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team and I reviewed it and we want to start planning the on‑prem transition path. Our security and infra teams have a few gating questions and would like a focused technical onboarding/architecture review. High level ask: a 90‑minute session that covers network prerequisites, air‑gap options, KMS/HSM integration, and an initial runbook for your on‑call support during the first 30 days.

Possible attendee list from our side: myself (Platform lead), Matt Greene (Security lead), plus one of our SREs (TBD). Can you share 3 possible windows next week? We’ll need an agenda and any pre‑reads so our security folks can triage before the meeting.

Also — we have a procurement touchpoint on Thursday; would it be useful to have a short billing/contract checklist attached to the onboarding packet?

Cheers,
Samira
Samira Patel
Platform Lead, Orbit Health

---
Note: attached a quick list we pulled together (orbit_prereq_checklist.pdf) as a reference; it’s preliminary.
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodesk.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted -> On‑Prem transition: architecture onboarding & on‑call planning

Hi Samira / Matt — great to hear you want to proceed.

We can run the 90‑minute deep dive and will include the topics you listed. Proposed agenda (draft):
- 0–10m: Intros, goals, success criteria for the pilot
- 10–40m: Network & VPC design choices (peering, NAT, egress rules, proxying)
- 40–70m: Air‑gapped options & data transfer patterns (seed images, update cadence)
- 70–85m: KMS/HSM integration, key rotation, and audit log requirements
- 85–90m: Next steps and simple runbook for first 30 days (oncall handoff)

Availability (Pacific time):
- Wed 6/30 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu 7/1 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Mon 7/5 11:00–12:30

I’m attaching our onboarding checklist and a short draft oncall rotation proposal for your review (redwood_oncall_rotation_draft.pdf). If procurement needs a separate checklist, Jordan — can we provide a 1‑pager summarizing billing cadence and SLAs?

Jordan and Vivek, FYI — Samira flagged that Orbit will likely request air‑gap deployment for their initial environment and KMS integration with Azure Key Vault + customer HSM. Can you confirm dev leads and the right Redwood SMEs to attend (runtime + network)?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Vivek Kulkarni
